_note: W1-e draft, BLOCKED: merge refuses MenuSelectionHandler.asm (transforms artifact), so this spec cannot be applied as it is; it records the corrected text for a later decision. Measured: 16 writes (8 cancels) of $090E / $0910 and no read of the four bytes in 54 sessions plus 11 displayModeFlags sessions.

edit.find: restores the original tiles and converts the cursor position to OAM-compatible sprite data at $090E/$0910.
edit.with: restores the original tiles and stores the graphics word address of the two cursor tiles in $090E/$0910 (nothing reads them).

ReadMenuSelection: Restore the tiles under the menu cursor and store their graphics addresses.

Restores the saved tiles ($0990/$0992) to their original BG3 buffer positions. For each of the two tiles it computes (tile AND $03FF) x 8 + $6000 and stores the result in $090E (first tile) and $0910 (second tile). The result equals the VRAM word address of the tile's 2bpp graphics when the BG3 character base is $6000 (8 words per tile); it is not an OAM tile word. Measured: the world-map menu cancel stores $6D60 in $090E and $6DE0 in $0910. Nothing reads $090E or $0910: both stores are dead. Clears the saved tile state.

256565.text: (tile AND $03FF) x 8 + $6000: graphics word address of the tile with a $6000 character base

256574.text: Store the first tile's address value in $090E; the second tile goes to $0910 (nothing reads either)
